name: DashCore
description: Android64 performance profiling with an isolated Bismuth-inspired GLES 3.1 compute/SSBO self-test. The original Geometry Dash renderer remains active; experimental render culling stays opt-in.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling
experimental-render-culling.description: Experimental off-screen render culling. Triggers and effects are always protected. Grouped objects are protected near the player and may be culled only when distant. Off by default; enable only for testing.
